messages.content: I'm not convinced this evidence supports the contraception criterion about inhibition of FSH preventing egg development and fertilisation. The candidate instead describes giving FSH to stimulate egg maturation for infertility treatment, which is the opposite mechanism, so it doesn't address inhibition of FSH for contraception. I'd check if the candidate mentions inhibition of FSH specifically elsewhere for contraception. Would you like me to look for that?

criterion.text: o inhibition of FSH (production / release) - lack of FSH prevents follicle / egg development / maturation - therefore there is no egg to fertilise
